title: Scenario update
description: Facilitator control card read aloud to the room to advance the story without a time jump (a visual or verbal inject delivered by the facilitator).

exerciseTime.description: Exercise clock when the card is read, H:MM

scenarioTime.description: In-scenario wall-clock time, if the update names it

headline.description: Short title of the development (5-8 words)

deliverTo.description: Who hears it: all players or one team

narration.description: Text the facilitator reads aloud, present tense, 3-6 sentences
examples: Every screen in the terminal is now black. Passengers are crowding the airline counters demanding information.

keyFacts.description: New facts players can act on (2-5 short lines)

examples: All FIDS screens are dark by Ops order

expectedAction.description: What the players are expected to do (from the MSEL), for the facilitator only
examples: Ops deploys staff with megaphones and whiteboards (Section 13.7 checklist).

facilitatorNote.description: Private note for the facilitator (not read aloud)
examples: Show the crowded-terminal photo on the projector while reading.
